newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent breaks lower in technical sell-off.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent breaks lower in technical sell-off.

text.p: IPE Brent extended losses in early evening trade to touch a new low in a technical follow-through to an earlier NYMEX-led downside move, brokers said.
Jan Brent was trading down 72 cents at $23.38 a barrel at 1844 GMT, having touched a low of $23.34.
"(NYMEX) heating oil broke down through 70 cents (a gallon) and (NYMEX crude) and Brent lost 20 cents," a broker said.
Dealers said that Brent's break through key support at $23.77 triggered technical selling stops.
